content.hi:
What is Completing the Square?
Is method mein hum equation ko (x + k)² = m ki form mein laate hain, jisse x easily nikal jaata hai.
• Perfect square trinomial: x² + 2kx + k² = (x + k)²
• Idea: x² + bx mein (b/2)² add karo taki perfect square ban jaaye
• Formula: x² + bx + (b/2)² = (x + b/2)²
• Yeh method har quadratic equation ke liye kaam karta hai

💡 Remember: (b/2)² add karna hai dono sides mein taki equation balance rahe!

content.hi:
The Key Identity
x² + bx + (b/2)² = (x + b/2)²
Yeh identity completing the square ka core concept hai. Jab bhi x² + bx dikhe, toh (b/2)² add kar do.
Example: x² + 6x + 9 = (x + 3)², kyunki (6/2)² = 9

content.hi:
Steps of Completing the Square
ax² + bx + c = 0 ko solve karne ke steps:
• Step 1: a ko 1 banao (sab terms ko a se divide karo)
• Step 2: Constant term (c/a) ko RHS mein le jaao
• Step 3: LHS mein (b/2a)² add karo
• Step 4: Same value RHS mein bhi add karo
• Step 5: LHS ko perfect square likho: (x + b/2a)²
• Step 6: Square root lo aur x nikaalo
